title: Quinoa Patties with Pumpkin, Peas and Curry
subtitle: in a coconut curry sauce
description: Pan-fried quinoa, pumpkin and pea patties lightly spiced with curry and ginger, finished in a warm coconut cream curry sauce with fresh coriander.

steps.text: Cook the quinoa: put the rinsed quinoa, water, 1/2 tablespoon oil and 1/4 teaspoon salt in a pot and bring to the boil. Cover and cook on medium heat for about 15 minutes until the water is completely absorbed.
Turn off the heat and wait another 10 minutes until the quinoa is cooked and white rings appear in the centre of the grains. Fluff with a fork and cool.

Make the patties: mix the quinoa, the pumpkin (cooked, drained and mashed with a fork), thawed peas, eggs, 1/2 teaspoon curry powder, 1 crushed garlic clove, ginger, 1 teaspoon finely chopped green chilli and the breadcrumbs in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Shape into flat patties about 4 cm across and fry in a thin layer of oil for about 2 minutes on each side until golden. Transfer to paper towel.

Make the sauce: heat the coconut cream, 1 crushed garlic clove, 1 teaspoon finely chopped green chilli, 1 teaspoon curry powder and a little salt in a pan for about 5 minutes until thickened. Adjust the seasoning.
Just before serving, add the patties to the sauce (on one side only), scatter with chopped coriander and serve.
